adaptations: For AI item use/search and experience gain only, Unity Random.Range(int,int) is replaced in the in-memory test copy by a test-supplied sequence. UOController Unity Debug.LogError output is suppressed so transaction rollback can run without native Unity logging. All troop rules, inventory effects, selection constraints, experience logic, optimizer and transaction IL come from the supplied assembly. UI/scene rendering is not simulated.

tests.name: All eleven legacy families have deterministic three-family mappings
Every old learned-troop mask migrates idempotently without fourth families
Current family and learned family remain consistent for all legacy combinations
Inventory migrates all eleven symbols without deleting items or altering equipment/formations
Learning a duplicate symbol cannot overflow the learned mask or add a fourth family
Troop counters obey exactly the requested nine-matchup cycle
Search choices cover only archer spear blade and model indices remain 3 1 0
World conversion includes marching/captured generals and exactly preserves troops capacity money
Twenty-plus level gains keep all current troops and retain unusual legacy capacity
Automatic item assignment recognizes merged symbols and leaves duplicate families unused
Automatic assignment does not relearn a ranged family already known under an old mask
Actual equipment transaction consumes assigned symbols and conserves all leftovers
Actual equipment transaction rolls back earlier removals when a later symbol is missing
AI actually consumes only newly learnable symbols and preserves duplicate inventories
AI search path generates each of the three symbols and no retired symbols
Real battle damage and visible selection paths call the shared troop rules
AI historical search now routes through the same eligibility gate as player search
Final assembly has migration hooks and all three search routes use the new symbol pool
